parameters.query:
INSERT INTO commodity_prices (commodity_name, commodity_code, price, unit, province, market_name, source, price_date)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.commodity_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.commodity_code ? "'" + $json.commodity_code + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.price }},
  '{{ $json.unit }}',
  '{{ ($json.province || 'Nasional').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.market_name || 'Rata-rata Nasional').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.price_date }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (commodity_name, province, price_date)
DO UPDATE SET price = EXCLUDED.price, market_name = EXCLUDED.market_name;

={
  "notification_type": "price_alert",
  "channel": "telegram",
  "subject": "⚠️ Alert Harga {{ $json.commodity_name }}",
  "message": "Harga {{ $json.commodity_name }} berubah {{ $json.change_pct ? $json.change_pct.toFixed(1) : 'N/A' }}%\nHarga baru: Rp {{ new Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID').format($json.price) }}/{{ $json.unit }}\nProvinsi: {{ $json.province }}",
  "triggered_by_workflow": "WF-04"
}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  commodity_name,
  province,
  price,
  change_pct,
  price_date,
  source
FROM commodity_prices
WHERE
  ({{ $json.commodity ? "'" + $json.commodity + "' ILIKE '%' || commodity_name || '%' OR commodity_name ILIKE '%' || '" + $json.commodity + "' || '%'" : 'TRUE' }})
  AND price_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '{{ $json.days }} days'
ORDER BY commodity_name, price_date DESC
LIMIT 500;
